name: TEMP - Country source validation
description: Temporary read-only workflow that samples recent Personality and MyQRCode tickets to determine which country source is reliable: audit IP location, submitting client, time zone, locale, or a country field.

parameters.content:
## TEMPORARY - country source validation

Read-only. Samples about 200 recent tickets per brand and reports, per channel, how often the creating audit carries a location, how concentrated the IPs are, and whether the submitting client is a browser or a server library. Also checks requester time zone, locale and any country-like field.

Delete once a country source has been chosen.
